title: Held-out data registry for Track B and the open-population lane
purpose: The single registry of held-out source years, editions, tables and partitions for every Track B gate and every open-population gate, set up by the dynamics coordinator on 2026-10-21. It is part of Track B's B0.2 exposure record (design revision 3, section 5.2, elements 4 and 5). Cite it by path, commit and SHA-256. src/populace_dynamics/track_b/holdout_registry.py states and enforces its rules, and tests/test_track_b_holdout_registry.py runs them on every commit.
rules: A gate registers every source year, edition, table or partition it holds out here before its record freezes.

J's candidate holdouts are registered first, because J is on Track B's critical path. OP0.2 registers its picks for OP12's gate_ssa_totals here before it freezes them, and picks from the years J has not taken.

No unit may be held out by two gates silently. Each entry names its units as unit_keys, colon-separated from the source down; two keys share a unit when one equals the other or is a prefix of it. Live entries that share a unit list each other in disclosed_overlaps, and both gates' registrations name the overlap.
Reference years are recorded separately from publication or interview availability (design section 5.2, element 10).

An entry whose gate has scored has status 'used', and scored_evidence names the committed artifacts of that run. Its units are exposure for every later gate and never again an unused holdout (design section 5.2).

Entries are only appended. An entry's id, gate, lane, source, unit_kind, units and unit_keys never change; its history, evidence, scored_evidence and disclosed_overlaps only extend. A status change is a new history item with its date and reason. Ids are never reused.

The registry is incomplete until completion_record, B0.2's mechanical exposure inventory, exists. It starts with the prior uses verified below; the inventory adds the rest before any B0.2 gate record freezes.

status_values.candidate: proposed by a gate's B0.2 or OP0.2 record; not yet frozen
status_values.frozen: fixed in a frozen gate record before that gate's candidates run
status_values.used: scored by a registered gate; exposure for every later gate
status_values.withdrawn: released before use, with the reason recorded
